tool_schemas.name: whois_lookup
tool_schemas.description: Runs a WHOIS lookup for the provided target and returns the captured raw output along with normalized registration metadata when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if target is missing or not a string, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to run OSINT tools, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has exceeded allowed run limits. Raises TOOL_ERROR when the underlying WHOIS execution fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: nmap_scan
tool_schemas.description: Runs an Nmap scan against the provided target and returns the raw scan output plus normalized findings (for example, detected hosts/ports/services when present). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if target is missing or not a string, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to run scans, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has exceeded allowed run limits. Raises TOOL_ERROR when the Nmap execution fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: dnsrecon_lookup
tool_schemas.description: Runs DNSRecon for the provided target and returns the raw output along with any normalized DNS enumeration results the run produces. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if target is missing or not a string, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to run OSINT tools, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has exceeded allowed run limits. Raises TOOL_ERROR when DNSRecon fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: dnstwist_lookup
tool_schemas.description: Runs DNSTwist for the provided domain and returns the raw output along with normalized permutation results when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if domain is missing or not a string, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to run OSINT tools, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has exceeded allowed run limits. Raises TOOL_ERROR when DNSTwist fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: dig_lookup
tool_schemas.description: Runs a dig query for the provided target and returns the raw command output plus any normalized DNS record data that can be extracted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if target is missing or not a string, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to run OSINT tools, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has exceeded allowed run limits. Raises TOOL_ERROR when dig fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: host_lookup
tool_schemas.description: Runs the host tool for the provided target and returns the raw output plus any normalized resolution results (such as forward/reverse records) when present. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if target is missing or not a string, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to run OSINT tools, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has exceeded allowed run limits. Raises TOOL_ERROR when the host command fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: osint_overview
tool_schemas.description: Generates a multi-tool overview for the provided target by aggregating available tool outputs and returning a consolidated report plus references to the underlying run results used to build it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if target is missing or not a string, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access OSINT reports, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has exceeded allowed report/run limits. Raises NOT_FOUND if no investigation/tool results exist for the target to summarize and TOOL_ERROR if report generation fails.

tool_schemas.name: list_investigations
tool_schemas.description: Lists investigations visible to the calling API client, optionally filtered by status and target attributes. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot be identified or is not permitted to view investigations.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the calling client.

target_type.description: Filter by target type when known.

created_after.description: Only return investigations created at or after this timestamp (RFC3339).

created_before.description: Only return investigations created before this timestamp (RFC3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of investigations to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list call.

tool_schemas.name: get_investigation
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single investigation by id, including its current status, requested_toolset, and timing fields. Raises NOT_FOUND if no such investigation exists for the caller, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access it.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the calling client.

investigation_id.description: Primary key of the investigation to fetch.

include_tool_runs.description: When true, includes associated tool_runs metadata (not artifacts) in the response.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_investigation
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of an investigation. If the investigation is queued or running, transitions it to cancelled and attempts to cancel any queued/running tool runs. Refuses requests for investigations already in a terminal state. Raises NOT_FOUND if the investigation is not accessible, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot cancel it, and INVALID_STATE when cancellation is not allowed from the current status.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the calling client.

investigation_id.description: Primary key of the investigation to cancel.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason recorded with the cancellation.

tool_schemas.name: list_tool_runs
tool_schemas.description: Lists tool runs visible to the calling API client, optionally filtered by investigation, tool_name, and status. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot be identified or is not permitted to view tool runs.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the calling client.

investigation_id.description: Filter runs for a specific investigation id.

status.description: Filter tool runs by lifecycle status.

created_after.description: Only return tool runs created at or after this timestamp (RFC3339).

created_before.description: Only return tool runs created before this timestamp (RFC3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of tool runs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list call.

tool_schemas.name: get_tool_run
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single tool run by id, including normalized metadata and status fields. Optionally includes artifact metadata and/or selected artifact contents. Raises NOT_FOUND if no such tool run exists for the caller, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access it.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the calling client.

tool_run_id.description: Primary key of the tool run to fetch.

include_artifacts.description: When true, includes artifact metadata (id, artifact_type, bytes, sha256, redacted, created_at).

artifact_types.description: When include_artifacts is true, restrict returned artifacts to these types.

include_artifact_content.description: When true, includes artifact content_text/content_json for returned artifacts (may be truncated/redacted).

tool_schemas.name: get_current_client
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated API client's identity and entitlements, including status, rate limits/quotas, and current rolling usage counters. Refuses access when the provided key is invalid or revoked. Returns the client record (excluding api_key_hash) plus computed usage for the current minute and rolling 24-hour windows.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the calling client.

metadata.name: OSINT Server
metadata.description: This backend stores OSINT investigations submitted via an API and the executed tool runs (whois, nmap, dnsrecon, dnstwist, dig, host) along with their outputs. The main workflow is: an API client creates/runs an investigation against a target, the system executes one or more OSINT tools, persists no
